title: Recipe tool input v2
description: Input for the trigger-phrase recipe tool. The trigger carries candidate_plant, crop, quantity and unit; the form may also set the optional target_fraction.

candidate_plant.description: Catalog common or scientific name, or a recipe-named plant string such as 'Nettle leaf'.

unit.description: Canonical unit m2; the accepted aliases are normalised to m2 before the tool runs.

target_fraction.description: Optional fraction of the crop requirement the nutrition track targets. Defaults to 1.0 (100%).
